title: European digital sovereignty, AI safety, and online rights
discussion_signal: The post summarizes public support for reducing external digital dependencies, investing in Europe-controlled services, and strengthening protection from disinformation, deepfakes, and online harms. It links sovereignty, safety, rights, and willingness to accept some cost in choosing European services.
linked_research_question: How do digital sovereignty, AI safety, child protection, and democratic safeguards become a public-demand and infrastructure agenda?
limits: Post is a secondary summary of the Eurobarometer
The audience is professional and platform-selected
Reported preferences do not establish willingness to bear actual costs
